description: Dublin Building Stock up to 2011 - via autoaddress.ie Postcodes is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rowan Molony. Central Statistics Office (CSO) Small Area cross-tabulation of period built | dwelling type anonymised to Postcode level via Dublin Postcode Boundaries - autoaddress.ie. Caveats: All ' 3' buildings (i.e. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
